name: Kryptonite Keeper Disc Lock
description: Kryptonite Keeper 5-S Disc Lock • Stapler style disc lock immobilizes vehicle to prevent roll-away or ride-away theft. • Dual-reinforced, high security, disc-style cylinder. • 5mm pin diameter fits smaller vent holes. • Compact and lightweight.
source_description_html:
Kryptonite Keeper 5-S Disc Lock

Features:

  • Stapler style disc lock immobilizes vehicle to prevent roll-away or ride-away theft
  • Dual-reinforced, high security, disc-style cylinder
  • 5mm pin diameter fits smaller vent holes
  • Compact and lightweight
  • Includes bright orange reminder cable to prevent riding away while disc lock is engaged
  • 2 stainless steel “I” keys
  • Key Safe Program

Dimensions:

  • 0.21” (5.5mm) locking pin diameter
  • 1.40 lbs
  • 1.63” (41.5mm) maximum distance for disc rotor insertion
  • 0.24” (6mm) maximum disc rotor thickness to insert lock
